<Rep. Robert C. "Bobby" Scott, Rep. Suzanne Bonamici, Rep. Mark DeSaulnier, Rep. Summer L. Lee, Rep. Adelita S. Grijalva>: For the reasons stated above, Committee Democrats unanimously opposed H.R. 2988 when the Committee on Education and Workforce considered it on June 25, 2025. We urge the House of Representatives to do the same.
Robert C. ``Bobby'' Scott,
Ranking Member.
Suzanne Bonamici,
Mark DeSaulnier,
Summer Lee,
Adelita Grijalva,
Members of Congress.
